_comment: Curated corrections for tools/gen_tap_sounds.py. The generator reconstructs
the entity -> tap-sound map from the extracted audio corpus; the game ships
no such table and a lot of audio stems match neither the display name nor the
animation slug. These entries are the residuals the automatic signals cannot
reach: a character whose voice file uses a nickname stem that is not any of
its own name/slug/family-stem keys and whose event bundle is not the
'cores'  keyed by the derived core stem (see gen_tap_sounds.core_stem).
'bases'  keyed by the exact tap file base name (wins over a core rule).
Each value is either "<kind>:<id>" or {"entity":"<kind>:<id>"}; use
{"exclude":true} to keep a stem silent (e.g. a pure ambient/prop loop).
Run with --report=PATH and grow this file from the unattributed report.
